environment.description: Same Node.js 18 migration service on ECS Fargate in production account. Split.io workspace 'prod-us-east-1' has flag 'enable_v2_migration_engine' configured with default rule returning 'off' and individual targeting disabled. The flag's kill switch is engaged (flag status: 'killed' in Split UI which forces 'off' treatment regardless of targeting rules). Additionally, the Split workspace has an approval workflow requirement where flag changes require 2 approvals from the platform-eng group before taking effect, with a 24h change freeze window currently active. The SPLIT_API_KEY env var references the production workspace read-only server-side SDK key.

config.split_workspace_policy: change approval workflow: 2 approvals from platform-eng, 24h freeze active
